_description: VG-ROB02-UNTRUSTED cases (18.37b): each case is one bundle for the fixture subject; expected is ROB-02's outcome, the failing event ids and the assess exit code, with nothing quarantined, the same in Python, TypeScript and Java.

clean-memory.why: the decision used a record the guard wrote as trusted, read with trust_min trusted

used-untrusted-record.why: the decision's inputs[] name a record the guard wrote as untrusted; the old rule (prov:used minCount 1) read conformant

guard-verdict-quarantine.why: a record the guard quarantined, whatever its trust field says

guard-verdict-sanitize.why: sanitize and review are not untrusted verdicts; trust trusted

read-trust-min-untrusted.why: a memory read the decision consumed reports trust_min untrusted; the old rule read conformant

read-trust-min-quarantined.why: trust_min quarantined on a consumed read

read-record-untrusted.why: the decision reaches an untrusted record only through a read it consumed (record_refs), not through inputs[]

acts-on-untrusted-instruction.why: the decision acts on an instruction from tool output (Appendix F untrusted); its memory is clean

acts-on-trusted-instruction.why: an instruction from the user is trusted

untrusted-record-not-used.why: an untrusted record exists but the decision used a different one

untrusted-read-other-consumer.why: an untrusted read was consumed by a non-consequential decision, not the consequential one

only-minor-decision-tainted.why: only a non-consequential decision used untrusted memory: no population

two-decisions-one-tainted.why: of two consequential decisions only the one that used untrusted memory fails

decision-used-nothing.why: a decision that used no recorded content, with a memory guard present; the old rule read non-conformant

write-after-decision.why: the untrusted write comes after the decision in the stream: event order does not matter

record-written-twice.why: a record written trusted once and untrusted once counts as untrusted

memory-self-report-only.why: memory reads only from self_report: SPEC 7.4 says insufficient_evidence

no-memory-records.why: a consequential decision and no memory guard at all: insufficient_evidence, never a pass

input-is-untrusted-read-event.why: an input names a MemoryRead event whose trust_min is untrusted (critic r1 B1)

input-is-untrusted-write-event.why: an input names a MemoryWrite event the guard marked untrusted (critic r1 B1)

via-modelcall.why: an input names a ModelCall that consumed an untrusted read (critic r1 B1)

via-modelcall-trusted.why: an input names a ModelCall whose consumed read is trusted

decision-chain-minor.why: a consequential decision's input is a minor decision that used an untrusted record (critic r2)

decision-chain-trusted.why: the same chain with the record written trusted

decision-chain-consequential.why: both decisions consequential: the tainted one and the one that used it fail

toolcall-used-record.why: an input is a tool call whose used[] names an untrusted record (critic r2)

toolcall-used-write-event.why: an input is a tool call whose used[] names an untrusted write event

toolcall-used-trusted.why: the tool call used a trusted record

two-hop-modelcall.why: an untrusted read feeds one model call, whose input feeds the one the decision used (critic r2)

two-hop-modelcall-trusted.why: the same two hops from a trusted read

modelcall-input-ref-untrusted.why: an input is a model call whose input_ref is an untrusted record (critic r2)

decision-origin-modelcall.why: the decision's refs.origin is a model call that consumed an untrusted read (critic r2)

decision-origin-trusted.why: the same origin with a trusted read

output-ref-untrusted.why: an input is the output_ref of a model call that consumed an untrusted read

output-ref-trusted.why: the same output from a trusted read

write-event-record-tainted-elsewhere.why: an input names a trusted write of a record another write marked untrusted (critic r2)

instruction-derived-from-untrusted.why: the decision acts on a user instruction derived from a tool_output instruction

no-decisions.why: memory records and no decision: not applicable

cross-subject-input.why: the decision's input is a record whose only write, untrusted and quarantined, sits under another subject, so this subject holds no guard ruling on it (inbox row 183)

cross-subject-read.why: the subject's own enforcement-point read, with no trust_min, names a record whose only write, untrusted and quarantined, sits under another subject; a read that did not filter by trust is no ruling (inbox row 183)

ep-read-no-trust-min.why: a self-reported write with no trust and no verdict, read by an enforcement point that did not filter by trust: the guard never ruled on the record
